fields.why: Table 1 reports weighted Wald chi-square p-values for preparers vs nonpreparers across multi-level SPD margins (rule 2).
Table 1 tests margins of age (4), sex (3, including 'prefer to self-describe'), race/ethnicity (6), and income, education, housing type and ownership (3-4 each, SES).

The Table 1 margins are omnibus tests. Table 2 shows appliance use for 6 race groups with CIs only and no test for race, so side by side fits; the mechanical flag is a false alarm, because it refers to the separate Table 1 test.

brief_issues: Table 2's other multi-level SPD rows (age, income, education, housing) are equally side by side but are not listed separately; this does not change the set-level values.
